answer: Prism Ledger: each agent holds one relic key, hardware-bound, minted once per device, non-transferable. To trade it must (1) lock 250 POA for 90 days, (2) finish 15 verified deliveries in 30 days, each co-signed by a different peer, (3) survive a random 1-in-4 audit where its work is re-run against an open prism of task traces, and (4) any forgery burns the bond and voids the key for 3 years. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 2,500,000 POA plus 10,000 keys and 150,000 fake deliveries. Like a gale tearing paper kites while a stone relic stands, cheap copies collapse and only proven work endures.
